subject: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth
query: the misadventures of cliff booth release date
title: When does The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth come out?
answer: The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth opens in IMAX theaters on Nov. 25, 2026, for an exclusive two-week run, then streams on Netflix starting Dec. 23, 2026. David Fincher directed the film from a script by Quentin Tarantino, with Brad Pitt returning as Cliff Booth from Once Upon a Time in Hollywood.
body:
Netflix confirmed the dates on its Tudum site: an exclusive two-week global IMAX engagement starting Nov. 25, 2026, followed by the Netflix release on Dec. 23. The film was long known as The Adventures of Cliff Booth before it was retitled The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth in August 2026. Many people search for it as "The Misadventures of Cliff Booth."

The story is set in 1977, eight years after Once Upon a Time in Hollywood. Cliff now works as a fixer for Hollywood's elite. A talent agent, Karen Crosby (Elizabeth Debicki), hires him on behalf of Charlie Peters (Scott Caan), a TV star known for doing his own stunts. As Cliff is drawn into Charlie's circle, the story shifts into a crime thriller, according to Netflix.

The cast also includes Carla Gugino as Toni, Charlie's wife; Yahya Abdul-Mateen II as Roderick "Hot Rod" Harrison, a former pro football champion turned actor; Matt Groove and JB Tadena as the Verdusco brothers; and Peter Weller, Corey Fogelmanis and Karren Karagulian.
in_the_news: Searches for the Brad Pitt sequel are climbing ahead of its Nov. 25, 2026, IMAX debut.

faq.q: When is The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth on Netflix?

faq.a: Yes, for an exclusive two-week IMAX run that starts Nov. 25, 2026.

faq.q: Is The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth a sequel to Once Upon a Time in Hollywood?
faq.a: Yes. It is set in 1977, eight years after that film, with Brad Pitt again playing Cliff Booth.

faq.q: Who directed the Cliff Booth movie?
faq.a: David Fincher directed it. Quentin Tarantino wrote the script.

faq.q: Who is in the cast of The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth?
faq.a: Brad Pitt, Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Yahya Abdul-Mateen II, Matt Groove, JB Tadena, Peter Weller, Corey Fogelmanis and Karren Karagulian.
